python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Values in billions of dollars (from page 24, Interest Total row)
fy1981 = 82.590  # FY 1981 cumulative in millions -> billions
fy1980 = 64.564  # FY 1980 comparable period in millions -> billions

# Box-Cox transformation with lambda = 0.75
# Formula: (x^lambda - 1) / lambda

lambda_val = 0.75

def box_cox(x, lam):
    if lam == 0:
        return math.log(x)
    else:
        return (x**lam - 1) / lam

fy1981_transformed = box_cox(fy1981, lambda_val)
fy1980_transformed = box_cox(fy1980, lambda_val)

print(f"FY 1981 value: {fy1981} billion")
print(f"FY 1981 Box-Cox transformed: {fy1981_transformed}")
print()
print(f"FY 1980 value: {fy1980} billion")
print(f"FY 1980 Box-Cox transformed: {fy1980_transformed}")
print()

# Calculate difference
diff = fy1981_transformed - fy1980_transformed
print(f"Difference: {diff}")

# Round to 4 decimal places
print(f"Difference rounded to 4 decimal places: {round(diff, 4)}")
EOF
